data.title: Reserve Bank of India: Report of the Advisory Committee on Ways and Means Advances to State Governments
data.summary:
The Reserve Bank of India has today placed on its website the Report of the Advisory Committee on Ways and Means Advances (WMA) to State Governments.
The Reserve Bank had constituted an Advisory Committee, under the Chairmanship of Shri I S N Prasad, former Additional Chief Secretary, Government of Karnataka. The terms of reference of the Advisory Committee included, inter alia, review of State-wise WMA limits and other financial accommodation facilities available to the States.
The Committee has made various recommendations which shall be examined by the Reserve Bank.
(Brij Raj)
Chief General Manager
Press Release: 2026-2027/1211

data.title: Reserve Bank of India: Underwriting Auction for sale of Government Securities for ₹33,000 crore on October 01, 2026
data.summary:
Government of India has announced the sale (re-issue) of Government Securities, as detailed below, through auction to be held on October 01, 2026 (Thursday).
As per the extant scheme of underwriting commitment notified on November 14, 2007, the amounts of Minimum Underwriting Commitment (MUC) and the minimum bidding commitment under Additional Competitive Underwriting (ACU) auction, applicable to each Primary Dealer (PD), are as under:
(₹ crore) Security Notified Amount MUC amount per PD Minimum bidding commitment per PD under ACU auction 6.20% GS 2029 9,000 215 215 6.57% GS 2033 12,000 286 286 7.63% GS 2056 9,000 215 215 7.50% GOI SGrB 2056 3,000 72 72 The underwriting auction will be conducted through multiple price-based method on October 01, 2026 (Thursday). PDs may submit their bids for ACU auction electronically through Reserve Bank of India’s Core Banking Solution (e-Kuber system) between 09:00 A.M. and 09:30 A.M. on the day of underwriting auction.
The underwriting commission will be credited to the current account of the respective PDs with RBI on the day of issue of securities.
Ajit Prasad
Deputy General Manager
(Communications)
Press Release: 2026-2027/1217
